subject: Post-demo: token budget range, $/1M target & model mix proposal
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire@vortexhealth.ai>, Tom Baker <tom@vortexhealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: token budget range, $/1M target & model mix proposal

Hi Claire / Tom — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and a concrete proposal so we can align on next steps.

Call highlights:
- Primary use case: patient triage + summarization workflows (high-context chat) and embeddings for search/rerank on clinical notes.
- Expected monthly volume (pilot): ~5M tokens inbound + generation (~approx 10M tokens processed) — we'll refine with your telemetry.

Preliminary commercial assumptions (for discussion):
- Target unit economics goal you mentioned on the call: $700–$900 per 1M tokens.
- Our baseline hosted estimate (no reserved commit): $950 / 1M tokens (includes streaming overhead, KV cache miss rate assumption 25%).
- With light caching + quantized medium models we can get < $800 / 1M tokens in pilot scenarios; dedicated/reserved paths get lower.

Model-mix proposal (initial pilot split by token consumption):
- Chat (contextual agent): 60% of tokens — recommended model family: redwood-chat-medium (quantized)
- Embeddings (search + similarity): 25% — recommended embedding-small (float16)
- Rerank (re-ranking candidates): 15% — reranker-light

Action items / ask:
1) Can you confirm the pilot monthly token range you expect (5M is our current working assumption)?
2) Is the $700–$900 per 1M tokens an accurate target range to design towards?
3) Any hard constraints on using private VPC or data residency for PHI in the pilot?

Attachments: Redwood-UnitEcon-v1.xlsx (unit econ scenarios), SOW-template.docx (standard SOW).

If that looks good I can loop in pricing to produce three formal scenarios (hosted pay-as-you-go, reserved pilot, and a short-term dedicated pilot) with per-model $/1M breakdowns.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
+1 (650) 555-0124

From: Claire Huang <claire@vortexhealth.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Baker <tom@vortexhealth.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03T18:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: token budget range, $/1M target & model mix proposal

Vanessa — thanks for the clear recap and the spreadsheet. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Pilot volume: we're looking at ~5M generated tokens / month (so your 10M processed estimate is in-line with our mix).
2) Budget target: the team has a stretch target closer to $700 / 1M tokens; absolute ceiling is $900 for pilot. If you can show a path to $700 with reasonable accuracy loss, that will get us greenlighted.
3) Model mix: our internal telemetry suggests embeddings will be a larger share for search-heavy flows — propose 30% embeddings, 55% chat, 15% rerank to start. Open to Redwood's recommended split if you show the cost delta.
4) Compliance: pilot will touch PHI; we need to confirm VPC option + KMS key control. Can you confirm?

Please also outline the timeline for a two-week pilot and what commit — if any — you recommend to achieve the $700 target. We'll need a draft SOW to review with legal.

— Claire
Claire Huang
Head of Product, Vortex Health
claire@vortexhealth.ai

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T20:00:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Vortex pilot pricing ask (target $700 / 1M) — need scenarios

Internal —

Claire pushed back to $700 / 1M as their stretch target, ceiling $900. Pilot ~5M gen tokens / month (10M processed). They also expect embeddings to be ~30% of tokens. PHI + VPC requirement (legal will need SOW).

Can you put together three scenarios we can send by EOD tomorrow? Need:
- Option 1: Hosted PAYG (no commit) — realistic $/1M and assumptions (cache hit, quantization)
- Option 2: Short reserved pilot (3 months / 5M commit) — discounted $/1M and break-even math
- Option 3: Dedicated short-term (2–3 month dedicated pool) — lower unit but commit required

Please include per-model $/1M breakdown (chat / embeddings / rerank) and an expected latency delta for each option. I attached the unit econ file for reference.

Vanessa

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire@vortexhealth.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T10:24:00-07:00
Subject: Nimbus / Vortex — SOW + three pricing scenarios (initial send)

Hi Claire / Vanessa — attaching the draft SOW and three pricing scenarios so you have concrete numbers to review. Summary below (all numbers per 1M tokens processed):

Option A — Hosted PAYG (no commit):
- Chat (redwood-chat-medium, quantized): $980 / 1M
- Embeddings (embedding-small): $720 / 1M
- Rerank (reranker-light): $520 / 1M
- Weighted blended: $880 / 1M (assumes 55% chat / 30% embed / 15% rerank)
- Notes: cache hit assumed 20%; higher hit rates reduce blended cost ~10–15%.

Option B — Short reserved pilot (3 months, 5M commit / mo):
- Chat: $720 / 1M
- Embeddings: $560 / 1M
- Rerank: $420 / 1M
- Weighted blended: $650 / 1M (with Vortex proposed 55/30/15)
- Notes: includes 15% reserved discount; requires committed volume and 30-day notice to scale down.

Option C — Dedicated short-term pool (2–3 months):
- Chat: $480 / 1M
- Embeddings: $350 / 1M
- Rerank: $300 / 1M
- Weighted blended: $430 / 1M
- Notes: lowest unit but requires dedicated capacity fee (~monthly platform + infra commit). Best for predictable, high-throughput production.

Quick commentary: Option B hits Claire’s stretch target of $700 for the blended scenario; Option C is best if they can accept a short dedicated commitment. We modeled quantization, KV cache assumed 25% hit, and batching aligned with 50 concurrent sessions.

Next steps:
- Claire: confirm pilot monthly commit (we used 5M gen tokens / mo) and preferred option.
- Vanessa: I'll update SOW with VPC/KMS language per Claire's compliance note and add expected timelines (2-week onboarding + 2-week pilot run).

Attachments: Nimbus-SOW-v1.pdf, pricing-scenarios.csv

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
